sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中走过七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星辰之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代冰淇淋。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个锅做出来的菜，因为我讨厌洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，访问 nytimes.com slash subscribe 获取优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: At the heart of President Trump's flurry of executive orders was a systematic dismantling of the country's current approach to immigration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统密集出台行政令的核心，是对该国现行的移民政策进行系统性的废除。

sentences.en: I spoke with my colleague, Hamid Ali-Aziz, about what the orders do and the message that they send.
sentences.zh: 我与我的同事哈米德·阿里-阿齐兹聊了聊这些行政令的内容以及它们传递的信息。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, January 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月22日，星期三。

sentences.en: Hamid, thank you for coming in the studio here in Washington, which is, the studio might be a little grandiose, so we're for what this is.
sentences.zh: 哈米德，谢谢你来到我们在华盛顿的录音室，虽然叫录音室可能有点大言不惭，我们就按它实际的样子来看吧。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Kind of a closet.
sentences.zh: 有点像个杂物间。

sentences.en: It's tight.
sentences.zh: 挺挤的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But it gets the job done.
sentences.zh: 但能把事情办成。

sentences.en: You have spent the past 24 hours or so studying President Trump's executive orders on immigration and what exactly they seek to accomplish.
sentences.zh: 你过去24小时左右一直在研究特朗普总统关于移民的行政令，以及它们究竟意欲达成什么目标。

sentences.en: So with the benefit of that huge amount of time that you've had to study this, how are you thinking about them individually and collectively?
sentences.zh: 那么，在你有幸花了这么长时间进行研究之后，你如何看待它们，无论是分别来看还是作为一个整体？

sentences.en: To me, it seems like President Trump is cramming, basically, four years of policy into one day.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，特朗普总统基本上是在把四年的政策塞进一天之内。

sentences.en: One half day.
sentences.zh: 半天之内。

sentences.en: One half day.
sentences.zh: 半天之内。

sentences.en: When you look back at the first Trump administration, it took them a long time to introduce policies like remain in Mexico or, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果你回看第一届特朗普政府，他们花了很长时间才推出诸如“留在墨西哥”之类的政策，或者，你知道的，

sentences.en: trying to strip federal funds from sanctuary cities, ban asylum.
sentences.zh: 试图剥夺庇护城市的联邦资金，禁止庇护。

sentences.en: All of that happened on Monday night within a matter of hours.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都在周一晚上短短几个小时内发生了。

sentences.en: And how would you describe the ultimate goal of all these things he crammed into this first half day?
sentences.zh: 你会如何描述他塞进这短短半天内的所有这些举措的终极目标？

sentences.en: This was a way for President Trump to reimagine our immigration system to crack down on the system as a whole, the ability of people to come to this country legally, illegally,
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普总统重塑我们移民系统的一种方式，旨在全面打击该系统，包括人们合法或非法来到这个国家的途径，

sentences.en: and in many ways to make it more uncomfortable for people who are already in this country unlawfully, you know, to have them rethink whether or not this is worth it.
sentences.zh: 并在许多方面让那些已经非法身处这个国家的人感到更加难受，你知道的，让他们重新考虑这到底值不值得。

sentences.en: Worth it, yeah.
sentences.zh: 值得，对。

sentences.en: The right place for them to be.
sentences.zh: 觉得这里是他们该待的正确地方。

sentences.en: And I think at the center of it, it's a condemnation, really, of the Biden administration's policies.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为其核心，实际上是对拜登政府政策的谴责。

sentences.en: What Trump saw, what Stephen Miller, what many in that circle saw was President Biden opening the borders,
sentences.zh: 特朗普所看到的、斯蒂芬·米勒所看到的、那个圈子里许多人所看到的，是拜登总统敞开了边境，

sentences.en: making it too easy for people to enter this country and remain indefinitely and allow them to work and live and have no consequences for being in the country unlawfully.
sentences.zh: 让人们太容易进入这个国家并无限期滞留，允许他们工作、生活，且非法身处国内却没有任何后果。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And just as a factual statement, under President Biden, undocumented immigration in the United States reached record levels.
sentences.zh: 而且作为一个客观事实，在拜登总统任内，美国的非法移民人数达到了历史最高水平。

sentences.en: So there's some basis for that complaint.
sentences.zh: 所以这种抱怨是有一定依据的。

sentences.en: So let's talk about the orders that Trump issued on Monday relating to immigration.
sentences.zh: 那我们来谈谈特朗普周一发布的关于移民的行政令。

sentences.en: So where should we start?
sentences.zh: 我们应该从哪里开始呢？

sentences.en: One of the first things that President Trump did is to get rid of a program that the Biden
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统做的第一件事之一，就是废除拜登

sentences.en: administration put into place in 2023, trying to change the way people were entering the country at the southern border.
sentences.zh: 政府在2023年实施的一项计划，该计划试图改变人们在南部边境进入该国的方式。

sentences.en: At some point during the Biden administration, they realized that the current status quo was not working.
sentences.zh: 在拜登政府任职期间的某个时候，他们意识到现有的现状行不通了。

sentences.en: Tens of thousands of people were crossing the border, seeking asylum and were being allowed to stay in the country indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 数以万计的人越过边境寻求庇护，并被允许在无限期留在国内。

sentences.en: They saw this as a major problem and an incentive for more people to come and to cross.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一个大问题，也是吸引更多人前来和越境的诱因。

sentences.en: So they thought one way to handle this is to set up a system through an app called CBP-1 where people could schedule appointments to enter the country at a port of entry.
sentences.zh: 所以他们认为应对的方法之一，是通过一个名为CBP-1的应用程序建立一个系统，让人们可以预约在入境口岸进入该国。

sentences.en: But if you crossed illegally, asylum access was no longer are going to be, you know, given to you.
sentences.zh: 但如果你非法越境，你将不再获得庇护资格。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So this app is an effort to bring some order to the chaos of the border during the Biden presidency.
sentences.zh: 所以这个应用程序是为了在拜登总统任内给边境的混乱带来一些秩序。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: The Biden administration felt like they were really providing a roadmap to stabilize the border.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府觉得他们确实是在为稳定边境提供一份路线图。

sentences.en: You could either come this way and you'd have a chance to stay in the United States, or you come illegally and we're going to turn you back, we're going to deport you, we're
sentences.zh: 你要么走这条路，就会有机会留在美国；要么你非法入境，我们就会把你遣返回去，我们会把你驱逐出境，我们会

sentences.en: going to send you back to your home country.
sentences.zh: 把你送回你的祖国。

sentences.en: And does this app end up working?
sentences.zh: 那这个应用程序最后起作用了吗？

sentences.en: Well, according to the Biden administration, it does.
sentences.zh: 嗯，根据拜登政府的说法，是的。

sentences.en: Ultimately, in the form of border numbers, the border numbers have been dropping throughout 2024.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，从边境数字来看，整个2024年边境数字一直在下降。

sentences.en: After the Biden administration put in tough restrictions at the southern border on asylum and paired it with this app, the numbers dropped precipitously.
sentences.zh: 在拜登政府对南部边境的庇护采取严厉限制并配合这个应用程序后，数字急剧下降。

sentences.en: As a point of comparison, you can look back to December 2023, nearly 250,000 people crossed the southern border.
sentences.zh: 作为对比，你可以回看2023年12月，将近25万人穿过了南部边境。

sentences.en: In that month alone.
sentences.zh: 就在那个月里。

sentences.en: In that month alone.
sentences.zh: 就在那个月里。

sentences.en: And you see from there to the end of December 2024, one year later, we're at 45, 46,000 crossings at the southern border.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到，从那时到2024年12月底，也就是一年后，我们在南部边境的越境人数降到了4.5万、4.6万人。

sentences.en: And on Monday, President Trump shut down this app.
sentences.zh: 而在周一，特朗普总统关闭了这个应用程序。

sentences.en: Why would President Trump shut down an app that seemed to be accomplishing what President Biden hoped it would do, which is to bring some predictability
sentences.zh: 为什么特朗普总统要关闭一个似乎正在实现拜登总统所希望达到的目标的应用程序，即给

sentences.en: to asylum-seeking and border crossing?
sentences.zh: 寻求庇护和边境越境带来一些可预测性？

sentences.en: at the U.S.-Mexico border.
sentences.zh: at the U.S.-Mexico border.

sentences.en: President Trump and Republicans, including Stephen Miller, saw this as another form of illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和包括斯蒂芬·米勒在内的共和党人认为这是非法移民的另一种形式。

sentences.en: These were people, in their eyes, who had no other lawful way to enter the United States through a visa.
sentences.zh: 在他们看来，这些人没有其他合法的签证途径进入美国。

sentences.en: And if you look at the numbers, since early 2023 to the end of 2024, more than 900,000 people used this app to enter the United States.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看数字，从2023年初到2024年底，有超过90万通过这个应用程序进入了美国。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: So while the numbers may have gone down overall once this app goes into place, there's still pretty big numbers by the end of a year.
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然一旦这个应用程序投入使用，总体数字可能有所下降，但在一年结束时，这仍然是个相当大的数字。

sentences.en: Entering the United States, exactly.
sentences.zh: 进入美国的人数，确实如此。

sentences.en: Republicans felt like when you're examining the number of arrests at the southern border every month, you need to add that total of people who are entering using this app,
sentences.zh: 共和党人认为，当你检查每个月南部边境的逮捕人数时，你需要将通过这个应用程序进入的人数总和加进去，

sentences.en: add that to the total of arrests as well at the southern border to get a better picture of what's happening at the border.
sentences.zh: 把这个数字也加到南部边境的逮捕总数中，以便对边境正在发生的事情有更全面的了解。

sentences.en: So essentially, Trump, Stephen Miller, those around them, would say that this app was a half-measure, an unsuccessful solution to the problem of border crossings.
sentences.zh: 所以从本质上讲，特朗普、斯蒂芬·米勒以及他们周围的人会说，这个应用程序只是个权宜之计，是解决边境越境问题的一个不成功的方案。

sentences.en: And it was facilitating illegal immigration.
sentences.zh: 而且它在助长非法移民。

sentences.en: So what happened once Trump ordered that the app be shut down?
sentences.zh: 那么在特朗普下令关闭该应用程序后发生了什么？

sentences.en: We saw pretty immediately people on the ground in Mexico processing this news, talking to our colleagues, saying they had this appointment,
sentences.zh: 我们相当快地看到身处墨西哥的实地民众在处理这一消息，他们与我们的同事交谈，说他们已经有了预约，

sentences.en: they'd been waiting for it for a long time, and they had no idea what was going to come next, what was going to happen to their cases, their ability to enter the United States.
sentences.zh: 他们已经等了很久，完全不知道接下来会发生什么，他们的案件会怎样，他们进入美国的能力会受到什么影响。

sentences.en: And according to a former Department of Homeland Security official who I spoke with,
sentences.zh: 根据我交谈过的一位前国土安全部官员的说法，

sentences.en: as of Monday morning, around 30,000 people had appointments to enter the country using this app.
sentences.zh: 截至周一上午，大约有3万人生通过这个应用程序预约入境。

sentences.en: And those appointments are now canceled.
sentences.zh: 而这些预约现在都取消了。

sentences.en: Is it right to think that what Trump accomplishes with this executive order that shuts down this app is he's effectively shutting down asylum?
sentences.zh: 认为特朗普通过这项关闭该应用程序的行政令所做的事情实际上是关闭了庇护通道，这种看法对吗？

sentences.en: Well, there's another order that handles asylum on the southern border.
sentences.zh: 嗯，还有另一项行政令处理南部边境的庇护问题。

sentences.en: What Trump does in this separate order is to immediately say that there's an invasion at our border and no longer can we allow people to cross into this country illegally
sentences.zh: 特朗普在这项独立的行政令中所做的是，立即宣布我们的边境遭到入侵，我们再也不能允许人们非法越境进入这个国家

sentences.en: and claim asylum and remain indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 并申请庇护以无限期滞留。

sentences.en: What Trump's saying here is, we're going to take the deterrence approach.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在这里所说的是，我们将采取威慑方法。

sentences.en: We're going to tell you no longer can you enter our country illegally and have a chance to stay.
sentences.zh: 我们要告诉你，你再也不能非法进入我国并获得留下的机会了。

sentences.en: So basically, Trump is taking away the route Biden had created to apply for asylum without crossing into the country.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，特朗普剥夺了拜登创建的无需越境即可申请庇护的途径。

sentences.en: And with this order, he's saying because of a surge of asylum seekers, what he calls an invasion, we're not replacing that with anything.
sentences.zh: 通过这项行政令，他表示由于寻求庇护者激增，也就是他所说的入侵，我们不会用任何东西来取代它。

sentences.en: Asylum, in effect, is over.
sentences.zh: 庇护实际上已经结束了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And how should we think about the underlying logic of that?
sentences.zh: 我们应该如何看待其背后的逻辑？

sentences.en: I think we've all come to understand that asylum as originally conceived is this concept that you are living in a place where life has become intolerably dangerous.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都逐渐理解，最初构想的庇护是一个概念，即你生活在一个生活变得危险到令人无法忍受的地方。

sentences.en: Perhaps you're on a government enemies liSt.
sentences.zh: 也许你在政府的黑名单上。

sentences.en: Perhaps gangs are threatening you or someone in your family.
sentences.zh: 也许帮派正在威胁你或你家里的某个人。

sentences.en: And at any moment, it feels like your life may end.
sentences.zh: 随时随地，你都会觉得自己的生命可能会终结。

sentences.en: That's been a traditional way of understanding why someone would apply for asylum.
sentences.zh: 这是理解为什么有人会申请庇护的传统方式。

sentences.en: And over the past eight years,
sentences.zh: 而在过去八年里，

sentences.en: it's felt like many coming to the United States seeking asylum are coming because their economic circumstances in their home countries are intolerable.
sentences.zh: 人们感觉许多来到美国寻求庇护的人之所以来，是因为他们在祖国的经济环境已经变得令人无法忍受。

sentences.en: and the system has been overwhelmed by a kind of broader understanding of why someone's seeking asylum.
sentences.zh: 由于对为什么有人寻求庇护有了更广泛的理解，这个系统已经不胜负荷。

sentences.en: Is that essentially what the Trump people are saying, is that the current system has encouraged too many people to invoke asylum, and as a result,
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是特朗普的人所说的吗，即现行系统鼓励了太多人援引庇护，结果导致

sentences.en: the entire system has become indefensible?
sentences.zh: 整个系统变得站不住脚？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全如此。

sentences.en: In the order itself, it details how our border system is not equipped to process people, to analyze their backgrounds, any potential
sentences.zh: 该行政令本身详细说明了我们的边境系统如何不具备处理人员、分析其背景以及任何潜在

sentences.en: criminal history that they have, and our current system just does not work.
sentences.zh: 犯罪记录的能力，我们现行的系统根本无法运作。

sentences.en: And to be fair, there is some bipartisan understanding of that.
sentences.zh: 平心而论，对此也有一些跨党派的共识。

sentences.en: I mean, Democrats have, you know, by and large, come to that conclusion as well.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，民主党人也大体上得出了这个结论。

sentences.en: The Biden administration echoed a lot of these talking points of how the asylum system as it is currently at the southern border is just not
sentences.zh: 拜登政府也呼应了许多这样的论点，即南部边境目前的庇护系统根本无法

sentences.en: operable, but they offer these other pathways, like the app.
sentences.zh: 运转，但他们提供了其他途径，比如这个应用程序。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They still defended it in principle.
sentences.zh: 他们原则上仍在为之辩护。

sentences.en: Trump is saying, don't even bother doing that.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普则表示，甚至不用费心去那样做。

sentences.en: The system just needs to end.
sentences.zh: 这个系统必须结束。

sentences.en: Yeah, the system needs to end, and also it's important to realize that, and to note here that in federal law, there is a provision that says that no matter the way somebody
sentences.zh: 是的，这个系统必须结束，而且同样重要的是要意识到并在此指出，在联邦法律中有一条规定：无论一个人

sentences.en: enters the United States, they are able to claim asylum.
sentences.zh: 以何种方式进入美国，他们都有权申请庇护。

sentences.en: So this is something that advocates, the ACLU, and others will point to when they inevitably sue the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 因此，当维权人士、美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）和其他人不可避免地起诉特朗普政府时，他们会指出这一点。

sentences.en: They'll say, this isn't the law.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，这不是法律规定的那样。

sentences.en: People have the ability to claim asylum, whatever way they enter the country.
sentences.zh: 人们有能力申请庇护，无论他们以什么方式进入这个国家。

sentences.en: What Trump is saying is that it's worth trying to shut down our southern border to stop this really high flow of people entering the country, what he terms as an invasion,
sentences.zh: 而特朗普所说的是，努力关闭我们的南部边境以阻止大量人员涌入这个国家是值得的，他将这称为入侵，

sentences.en: millions of people coming into the country in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来有数百万人涌入这个国家。

sentences.en: And he's looking with his other executive orders for a way to close the door and other pathways for immigrants who are seeking refuge in this country,
sentences.zh: 他正通过其他行政令寻找一种方法来关上大门，并关闭那些寻求在该国避难的移民的其他途径，

sentences.en: closing those doors one by one.
sentences.zh: 一扇接一扇地关上这些大门。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“连线”（Connections）字谜。

sentences.en: and I love horror movies.
